subject: Invoice publish authority and recipient mapping
messages:
From: Emily Chen <e.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: LedgerWorks Billing <billing@ledgerworks.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice publish authority & recipient mapping

Hi Sergio,

Quick question from procurement as we prepare to go live with Redwood: who will be the canonical "publisher" of invoices for billing and tax purposes? Our AP team needs to know whether invoices will come from a Redwood billing sender (billing@redwoodinference.com) or if LedgerWorks (our payment processor) will emit on Redwood's behalf.

Also:
- Preferred delivery: portal webhook (preferred) or emailed PDFs to ap-invoices@acmecorp.com?
- PO handling: can PO numbers be injected into the invoice subject line and in an invoice_reference field in the metadata?
- VAT evidence: do you attach VAT IDs per invoice or provide a monthly CSV file?

We'd like a short mapping (who sends, who copies AP, where VAT proof lives) so we can configure our AR system. Ideally a test invoice to test@acmecorp.com before production.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Acme Corp

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice publish authority & recipient mapping

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Short answers first, then proposed mapping below.

- Default publisher: Redwood (billing@redwoodinference.com).
- Delivery: default is emailed PDFs + XML metadata copy; we can configure a primary portal webhook (recommended for AP automation) and keep email copies to ap-invoices@acmecorp.com as a fallback.
- PO: yes — we can put the PO in the subject and emit a structured invoice_reference field in the metadata.
- VAT evidence: we can attach VAT ID per invoice and/or generate a monthly vat_ids.csv — happy to do whichever you prefer.

Proposed publish/recipient mapping (summary):
1) Primary: Portal webhook -> Acme AP endpoint (we will POST invoice PDF + JSON metadata).
2) Secondary: Email copy -> ap-invoices@acmecorp.com (PDF).
3) Audit/Archive: billing@redwoodinference.com (sender) + ledgerworks@billing (bcc for settlement only).

Attached: invoice_publisher_matrix.xlsx — shows fields we will include in the webhook payload and subject formatting examples.

Next steps: Kimberly and Connor will confirm the payload fields and schedule a test invoice. Can you confirm the test address and any required header format for PO placement?

Best,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <e.chen@acmecorp.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice publish authority & recipient mapping

Emily — a couple of clarifying points from the AP integration side so we can finalize the webhook payload: 

Key fields we'll include in the JSON metadata:
- invoice_id (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- total_amount (decimal)
- currency
- po_number (string) — will also be added to the e-mail subject if provided
- invoice_reference (free text)
- vat_ids_attached (boolean)
- ap_contact (name + email)

VAT evidence options:
- Option A (per-invoice): include a small csv/attachment with supplier VAT ID(s) as part of the POST body.
- Option B (monthly): we publish a monthly vat_ids.csv to your SFTP or to a secure share (choose this if you want fewer attachments).

PO placement: we prefer PO in the subject as "PO {po_number} — Invoice {invoice_id}" (systems prefer predictable prefixes).

We'll aim to produce a test invoice to your test mailbox. Connor — can you provision the webhook and do a dry-run with a signed sample PDF?

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <e.chen@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice publish authority & recipient mapping

Thanks Kim — that looks good. We confirm the following for Acme: 

- Preferred delivery: Portal webhook is primary. Please POST PDF + JSON metadata to our endpoint: https://ap.acmecorp.com/invoices/webhook (auth: mTLS).
- Email copy: keep ap-invoices@acmecorp.com in CC for records.
- PO formatting: Subject should be "PO 40921 — Invoice {invoice_id}". That works.
- VAT evidence: attach VAT ID per invoice for the first 3 months while we reconcile; after that switch to a monthly vat_ids.csv delivered to SFTP if that is easier.
- Test address: test@acmecorp.com (please send a signed sample).

AP contact for integration: Rita Morales <rita.morales@acmecorp.com> (x: +1-415-555-0199). She will validate the payload and certificate.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll expect the test invoice and webhook as discussed.

Emily
Emily Chen
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Acme Corp

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice publish authority & recipient mapping

Emily / Rita (cc'd on subsequent welcome email) — confirmed. Actions from Redwood: 

- Connor will provision the webhook to https://ap.acmecorp.com/invoices/webhook (mTLS will be used).
- We will send a signed sample invoice to test@acmecorp.com on Friday, 2026-09-03.
- VAT approach: per-invoice attachments for first 3 months, then monthly vat_ids.csv to your SFTP.
- Subject line format: "PO 40921 — Invoice {invoice_id}" implemented.

Attachments included for the test: sample_test_invoice.pdf (signed sample) and vat_ids.csv (recent supplier VAT list).

If those items look good we'll update the billing runbook and flip the portal to primary on the go-live date.

Thanks all — will follow up with a short runbook link and the test timestamp.

Sergio
